description: This Java class is a command handler for updating SMS entities within the Apache Fineract project. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, receives a JSON command, and delegates the update operation to the SmsWritePlatformService.

classes.name: UpdateSmsCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles update commands for SMS entities in the Fineract system. It processes commands annotated for SMS updates and delegates the update operation to the SmsWritePlatformService.

methods.name: UpdateSmsCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the SmsWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the JSON command to update an SMS entity by calling the update method on the writePlatformService.
